entities.summary: Nuseir Yassin, known professionally as Nas Daily, is an Israeli-Palestinian vlogger, entrepreneur and media personality of Palestinian descent. He is best known for his travel vlog videos on YouTube, Facebook, TikTok and Instagram, amassing 14 million subscribers in the former, as well as managing training programs for content creators under Nas Academy. Yassin has received criticism for his views on the Israeli–Palestinian conflict.
